parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English

parameters.name: AppIds
parameters.description: The IDs of applications. Separate multiple application IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: CanaryModel
parameters.description:
The canary release mode.

- 0: Content-based routing

- 1: Proportional routing

parameters.name: DbGrayEnable
parameters.description: This parameter is deprecated. Specifies whether to enable canary release for databases.

parameters.name: EntryApp
Id
parameters.description: The ID of the lane group. If you set this parameter to -1, a lane group is created. If you set this parameter to a value greater than 0, the specified lane group is modified.

parameters.name: MessageQueueFilterSide
parameters.description: The side for message filtering in a canary release.

parameters.name: MessageQueueGrayEnable
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable canary release for messages.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the lane group.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The name of the MSE namespace.

parameters.name: Paths
parameters.description: This parameter is deprecated. This parameter is used when a Java gateway is the entry application.

parameters.name: RecordCanaryDetail
parameters.description: Specifies whether to record the details of canary release requests.

parameters.name: RouteIds
parameters.description: The list of route IDs. If a cloud-native gateway is used as the entry application, you must call this operation to pass the list of route IDs for the cloud-native gateway before you create a lane for the lane group.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Specifies whether the lane group is enabled. A value of 0 indicates that the lane group is disabled. A value of 1 indicates that the lane group is enabled.

parameters.name: SwimVersion
parameters.description: The version of the end-to-end canary release. Valid values: 0 and 2. A value of 0 is not recommended because you must specify a route. A value of 2 is recommended because you do not need to specify a route.
